skill.name: context-management
skill.description: Manage context for multi-agent workflows, long-running projects, and persistent memory. The skill helps capture decisions, prepare handoffs, compress context, and organize project knowledge.
skill.summary: Capture, compress, and hand off project context across agents and sessions.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown code fences or ordinary prose. The confirmed static risks are filesystem examples that use predictable /tmp paths and broad glob matching. A semantic issue remains because the memory guidance suggests preserving credentials in persistent context.

remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated workspace directory, randomized filenames, strict permissions, and cleanup instead of predictable /tmp files and broad globs.
Remove credentials from the preservation list and instruct users to store only redacted references or secret-manager pointers.

content.value_statement: Long-running AI work often loses decisions, blockers, and session state. This skill provides practical workflows for checkpoints, handoffs, memory records, and compact context sharing.
actual_capabilities: Captures key decisions, rationale, blockers, and active work for later sessions.
Prepares short or full handoff context for another agent or workflow stage.
Provides patterns for file-based context artifacts and coordination notes.
Guides persistent memory organization with entities, observations, and relationships.
Supports context compression by removing redundant details and preserving key facts.
Offers templates for completion and blocked-task handoffs.
limitations: Does not execute coordination automatically or create files without agent action.
Requires the user or agent to decide what information is safe to store.
Memory workflows depend on a compatible memory tool or manual tracking process.
Examples are guidance patterns, not tested automation scripts.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Agent Handoffs
use_cases.description: Prepare focused context for the next agent, including current state, decisions, blockers, and expected next actions.

use_cases.title: Resume Long Projects
use_cases.description: Create checkpoints that help a developer continue work after breaks, session changes, or task interruptions.

use_cases.title: Maintain Project Memory
use_cases.description: Organize project knowledge with entities, observations, and relationships so important decisions remain searchable.

prompt_templates.title: Capture Current Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Capture the current project context. Include the active goal, recent decisions, blockers, files involved, and next actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner checkpoint for a single active task.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Agent Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a handoff for the next agent. Include only context relevant to its task, expected output, and known constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate handoff for a multi-agent workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Compress Session History
prompt_templates.prompt: Compress this session into a short context summary. Preserve decisions, rationale, unresolved questions, and risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced summary when token budget is limited.

prompt_templates.title: Build Memory Graph Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a memory graph plan for this project. Define entities, observations, relationship types, update rules, and safe storage boundaries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced persistent memory setup for long-running work.

output_examples.input: Capture context before this coding session ends.
output_examples.output: A concise checkpoint with the current goal, completed work, open decisions, blockers, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Prepare a handoff for a reviewer agent.
output_examples.output: A reviewer-focused brief with changed areas, design choices, test status, risks, and files to inspect.

output_examples.input: Compress our project memory for a new session.
output_examples.output: A short project memory summary that keeps durable facts and removes resolved discussion details.

best_practices: Store decisions with the reason, date, and affected project area.
Redact credentials and personal data before saving context.
Use short handoffs for routine transitions and full context for complex work.
anti_patterns: Saving full conversation transcripts when a short checkpoint is enough.
Recording credentials, tokens, or private data in persistent memory.
Passing every detail to each agent instead of tailoring context to the task.

faq.question: What does this skill help manage?
faq.answer: It helps manage context across agents, sessions, checkpoints, and persistent project memory.

faq.question: Does it run automation by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflows, templates, and organization patterns for an agent or user to apply.

faq.question: Can it help with Claude and Codex workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is written for AI work in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should not be stored in memory?
faq.answer: Do not store credentials, tokens, private personal data, or secrets in persistent context.

faq.question: When should I use a short context summary?
faq.answer: Use it for routine handoffs when the next agent only needs goals, decisions, blockers, and next steps.

faq.question: When should I use full context?
faq.answer: Use full context for complex work that needs architecture, dependencies, decisions, and active work streams.
